name: observability-runtime-proof
truth_boundary: This contract verifies selected observability wiring in a GitHub-hosted Docker Compose environment. It is not production readiness, external-user validation, or physical-PC validation.

checks.claim: OpenTelemetry Collector is running in the observability Compose profile.
Grafana Alloy is running and available to collect Docker logs.
Prometheus reports all five configured Aetheris core scrape jobs healthy.
Representative authenticated and health-check traffic is generated for telemetry verification.
Prometheus returns a positive HTTP server request counter from the running services.
Tempo reports receiving spans through the configured OTLP path.
Loki exposes service-labeled container logs collected by Alloy.
Grafana exposes provisioned Prometheus, Loki, and Tempo datasources.
Grafana exposes at least one provisioned dashboard.
